title: [GMCP 203.021.M] Mastery: Local MCP gateway, reverse proxy, and aggregation plane
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-021-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP exposes many local or remote servers as one policy-enforced endpoint while preserving original server identity, capabilities, schemas, errors, progress, cancellation, subscriptions and trace context. Routing and transformation are deterministic; backpressure, quotas and failure isolation prevent one backend from harming others; and direct-versus-gateway differential tests prove no semantic loss. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
